# 📂 Data Directory

Place your datasets here:

## Required Files

| File | Source | How to Get |
|------|--------|------------|
| `factify_train.csv` | [FACTIFY (IIT Jodhpur)](https://competitions.codalab.org/competitions/35153) | Register, download, place here |
| `wnli_train.csv` | [IndicGLUE (AI4Bharat)](https://github.com/ai4bharat/indic-glue) | Download raw CSV from repo |

## Auto-Generated Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `telugu_factify.csv` | Generated by `python -m src.filter_factify data/factify_train.csv data/telugu_factify.csv` |
| `telugu_news.parquet` | Generated by `python download_all.py` (RSS scrape) |

## Notes
- The FACTIFY dataset requires manual registration and acceptance of terms
- Telugu news scrape data is auto-generated from Sakshi, Eenadu, TV9 RSS feeds
- All data files are excluded from git via `.gitignore`
